title: Debris from fresh China rocket launch may have fallen near Tubbataha Reef, PhilSA warns
summary: China on Thursday morning conducted a fresh rocket launch whose debris may have fallen near the Tubbataha Reefs Natural Park off Puerto Princesa, Palawan, the Philippine Space Agency warned Thursday.
